note: The skill's session is a watcher on Opus 5.5: it starts each stage in a session of its own (setup: Opus 5.5 high; evaluation and ordering: Fable 5.2 medium; examples: Opus 5.5 high; the proof loop: the evaluating session continued, Fable 5.2 high), keeps a verification loop on Sonnet 5.5, prints a summary every 10 minutes, judges each cycle, merges queued workspaces between examples, and lets the loop start the next example while a final proof runs (--wait-for-proofs turns that off).
